risk_summary: The company reports modest sales contraction and materially lower net income and EPS, driven by COVID-19 effects, supply-chain disruption, tariffs, and acquisition-related expenses. Management maintains a cautiously positive outlook based on backlog, market diversification, and expected efficiency gains, but several forward-looking claims are qualitative and dependent on uncertain market conditions. Liquidity is positive, although most cash is held by foreign entities and inventory increased due to demand shifts and supply-security efforts.
